adjudication.basis: Detailed KG-grounded contextual explanation/guidance method for query disambiguation,faceted browsing and recommendation; protocol permits primary guidance methods with implementation/evaluation pending.

backend.source_model_description: RDF/LinkedDatahostknowledge; ontology interaction/knowledgepattern catalogs and OWLalignments; plannedApacheStanbolplugins with SWRL-compatible/SPARQLrules. No current production backend implemented.

descriptions.interaction: Proposed response to user/system interaction traces; semantic entity-disambiguation synopsis and explanations for browsing/recommendation. No completed deployed UI established.
descriptions.guidance: MapinteractionpatterntoKGentities,matchknowledgepatterns,selectweightedasserted/inferredfacts conditioned on user context/profile,assemble differentiating entity explanations.
descriptions.visualisation: Proposed tooltip/text explanation; workflow/ontology diagram not current interactive KG visualization.
descriptions.backend: RDF/LinkedDatahostknowledge; ontology interaction/knowledgepattern catalogs and OWLalignments; plannedApacheStanbolplugins with SWRL-compatible/SPARQLrules. No current production backend implemented.
descriptions.evaluation: Method proposal with GeorgeBushentitydisambiguation example; no recruited/performance study.
